based_on: catalog_v1_draft + eval/match_gold_v1_1.json new_products + menu names of the held-out bars (labels v1.1: 미라보, Beck, 포레스트) + POST_TEST_ALIASES (match_gold_test_draft.py) + eval/match_gold_final_v1.json new_products and menu names (수이, 오드비)
notes: ids are UUIDv5(namespace 6b1a1f4e-19b0-4c7a-9a7e-b0771e3a0019, '<kind>:<key>'): stable across rebuilds.
normalized_alias is intentionally omitted: backend normalization function generates it.
'sources' on aliases is metadata for evaluation scripts only; the loader can ignore it.
abv is null for all products in v1 (not on menus; not filled from memory).
products[].sources / first_seen are evaluation-only fields: the bars whose menu lists the product, and the first of them. The loader ignores them.
Menu aliases are the printed line names (labels v1.1, labels_final_v1); a 'Korean / English' line gives one alias per part; the Odbi event note ' / 행사' is not part of the alias.
menu:수이 / menu:오드비 aliases are the final (P47) bars' own spellings: catalog_v2_eval_5bars.json drops aliases whose only sources are these two.
New-product test snapshot: as catalog_v2_eval_5bars, and products seen only at 수이·오드비 (plus brands left without products) removed.
